Wonderful lot of two vintage 1940s illustrated children’s books featuring an especially collectible First Edition Walt Disney Fantasia title.

Dance of the Hours from Walt Disney’s Fantasia is clearly marked First Edition and copyright 1940 by Walt Disney Productions. Published by Harper & Brothers and printed in the United States by Western Printing and Lithographing Company. Features the colorful characters from the “Dance of the Hours” sequence of Disney’s landmark Fantasia.

Also included is Eric Knight’s classic Lassie Come-Home, illustrated by Marguerite Kirmse. This is a WWII-era Victory Book edition, printed on lighter-weight paper in accordance with War Production Board regulations. Copyright 1940 by The John C. Winston Company, with the printing history shown through the thirteenth printing, November 1943.
Both books show visible age and use consistent with their 1940s vintage, including cover, edge and corner wear. The colorful original cover artwork remains especially charming and displayable. Please review all photos carefully for condition and edition/printing details.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Cross
Writing Instrument Lot - 4 Pieces
Gold and Silver Toned, Vintage
A collection of four vintage Cross writing instruments, representing the classic American craftsmanship of the A.T. Cross Company. These pens feature the iconic slim silhouette and conical tops that have defined the brand's aesthetic for decades. This lot includes two distinct pairs in gold and silver-toned finishes, providing a range of styles for collectors or daily use.
Items Included:
Gold-toned ballpoint pen with vertical linear engine-turned texture and personalized script engraving, housed in a clear display case.
Silver-toned chrome ballpoint pen with a smooth polished finish and signature pocket clip, housed in a clear display case.
Gold-toned ballpoint pen featuring a "Hostess" heart tag, housed in a black presentation box.
Silver-toned chrome ballpoint pen with a sleek, minimalist finish, housed in a black presentation box.
One additional Cross ballpoint pen refill included.
Condition:
The metal bodies of all four pens exhibit signs of use, including visible surface scratches and scuffs, which are more prominent on the chrome finishes. One gold-toned pen features a personalized script engraving. The internal twist mechanisms are intact, though the pens have not been tested for ink flow or writing functionality. The display cases show moderate shelf wear, including surface scuffing and light scratches to the clear plastic components.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Temporarily Unavailable:
Item combining is
temporarily unavailable while we transition to a new system
. During this time, orders must be shipped individually and cannot be combined for reduced shipping charges. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we complete this update. Once our new system is fully in place, combined shipping options may become available again.
Items will not be dismantled for any reason, no exceptions. Pure "Buy-It-Now" items cannot be combined per ShopGoodwill.com guidelines.
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

This listing features a Conklin Endura Symetrik fountain pen with a marbled green and black celluloid barrel and cap. The pen includes gold-filled trim and double cap bands. The nib is gold-toned with Conklin engraving.

Specifications:
Brand: Conklin
Model: Endura Symetrik
Material: Marbled green and black celluloid
Trim: Gold-filled with double cap bands
Nib: Gold-toned, engraved with Conklin name
Barrel Imprint: TRADE CONKLIN MARK TOLEDO, OHIO, USA
Clip Hardware: Gold-colored with patent dates May 28, 1918 and Nov. 17, 1925
Production Era: 1930's

https://www.fedex.com/content/dam/fedex/us-united-states/services/Fees_Shipping_Information.pdf

4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
The items purchased are all from Youngstown Area Goodwill.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
3 items or less with a combined shipping weight that does not exceed 20 pounds.

description: This vintage Sheaffer set includes a ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil, both finished in brushed stainless steel. Each features a sleek design with a shiny chrome clip and the distinctive Sheaffer white dot. The set comes with the original Sheaffer instruction manual for use and refilling. Both writing instruments are in very good used condition with minor signs of wear. No personalization or engravings are present. Suitable for collectors or vintage office use.

description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

description:
Wahl Signature
Gold Filled Ring Top Fountain Pen
Early 20th Century
This vintage Wahl Signature fountain pen features a gold-filled case with a classic chased geometric pattern. Produced during the golden age of American writing instruments, this "ring top" model was designed for portability, intended to be worn on a watch chain or chatelaine. The nib is clearly marked "Wahl Signature Pen 14K," identifying the high-quality gold content characteristic of these premium writing tools. The barrel is personalized with the engraved name "E. BURKLE."
Wahl Signature 14K gold nib (tested and marked)
Vintage gold filled case with decorative chased design
Ring top attachment for chain or lanyard use
Lever-filler mechanism for ink loading
Approximately 3.75 inches in length
Condition:
Vintage condition with visible signs of age and use. The gold-filled surface shows a natural aged patina and minor surface scratches; no significant dents or plating loss observed on the exterior. The personalized engraving "E. BURKLE" is deep and legible. The internal section shows significant ink residue and oxidation at the threads and section joint. The nib shows surface wear and staining but remains structurally intact. The filling mechanism has not been restored; functionality of the internal ink sac is unknown and should be assumed to require service for writing use.
Warehouse Location: Canton

Description:
Add a touch of historic charm to your decor or collection with this genuine Hemingray-42 glass insulator in striking aqua blue. Renowned for their iconic craftsmanship and durability, Hemingray insulators were essential on telephone and telegraph lines in the early-to-mid-20th century. This piece features beautiful embossed branding, a thick glass body, and a delightful beaded rim detail, making it both visually attractive and functional. Whether displayed as a standalone accent, repurposed for creative DIY projects, or included in a larger antique glass collection, this insulator offers lasting appeal and nostalgia. Own a slice of industrial history, manufactured in the USA and sure to impress both collectors and design enthusiasts alike. Buy confidently, knowing this is an authentic vintage piece, ideal for gifting or personal enjoyment.

Description:
Discover the natural beauty and calming energy of this set of four assorted mineral specimens perfect for home decor, meditation, or as a thoughtful gift. This collection includes one polished, clear selenite wand renowned for its luminous surface and reputed cleansing properties. Also included are two sparkling geode halves, each showcasing glittering quartz crystals set within earthy stone matrices.
